Imports System.Collections.Generic ' ===================================================================== ' Export Assembly Tree + iProperties + Constraints/Joints to CSV ' iLogic rule - run from the top-level assembly (.iam) ' ' Output (written next to the assembly file): ' <AssemblyName>_Tree.csv -> full component tree with iProperties ' <AssemblyName>_Constraints.csv -> all constraints + joints, every level ' =====================================================================
Sub Main() Dim doc As Document = ThisDoc.Document If doc.DocumentType <> DocumentTypeEnum.kAssemblyDocumentObject Then MessageBox.Show("Please open an assembly (.iam) before running this rule.", _ "Export Assembly Tree", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning) Exit Sub End If
Dim asm As AssemblyDocument = CType(doc, AssemblyDocument) Dim asmName As String = System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(asm.FullFileName) Dim outFolder As String = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(asm.FullFileName) If String.IsNullOrEmpty(outFolder) Then outFolder = "C:\Temp" ' unsaved assembly If Not System.IO.Directory.Exists(outFolder) Then System.IO.Directory.CreateDirectory(outFolder)
' ---------- Tree ---------- Dim tree As New List(Of String) tree.Add(Row("Level", "Tree", "Occurrence Path", "File Name", "File Type", "Full Path", _ "Part Number", "Description", "Revision", "Material", "Stock Number", _ "Designer", "Project", "BOM Structure", "Suppressed", "Grounded", _ "Visible", "Custom iProperties"))
' Row for the top-level assembly itself tree.Add(Row("0", asmName, asmName, System.IO.Path.GetFileName(asm.FullFileName), ".iam", _ asm.FullFileName, _ GetProp(asm.PropertySets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Part Number"), _ GetProp(asm.PropertySets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Description"), _ GetProp(asm.PropertySets, "Inventor Summary Information", "Revision Number"), _ "", _ GetProp(asm.PropertySets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Stock Number"), _ GetProp(asm.PropertySets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Designer"), _ GetProp(asm.PropertySets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Project"), _ asm.ComponentDefinition.BOMStructure.ToString(), "False", "", "True", _ GetCustomProps(asm.PropertySets)))
' ---------- Constraints / Joints ---------- Dim cons As New List(Of String) cons.Add(Row("Assembly", "Kind", "Name", "Type", "Component 1", "Component 2", _ "Offset / Angle", "Suppressed", "Health"))
Dim visited As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ExportConstraints(asm.ComponentDefinition, asmName, cons) visited.Add(asm.FullFileName)
WalkTree(asm.ComponentDefinition.Occurrences, 1, asmName, tree, cons, visited)
' ---------- Write files (UTF-8 with BOM so Excel shows umlauts) ---------- Dim treeFile As String = System.IO.Path.Combine(outFolder, asmName & "_Tree.csv") Dim consFile As String = System.IO.Path.Combine(outFolder, asmName & "_Constraints.csv") System.IO.File.WriteAllLines(treeFile, tree, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8) System.IO.File.WriteAllLines(consFile, cons, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8)
MessageBox.Show("Export complete:" & vbCrLf & treeFile & vbCrLf & consFile, _ "Export Assembly Tree", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information) End Sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Recursive tree walk ' --------------------------------------------------------------------- Sub WalkTree(occs As ComponentOccurrencesEnumerator, level As Integer, parentPath As String, _ tree As List(Of String), cons As List(Of String), visited As HashSet(Of String)) For Each occ As ComponentOccurrence In occs WriteOccurrence(occ, level, parentPath, tree, cons, visited) Next End Sub
' Top level uses ComponentOccurrences (different type than the enumerator) Sub WalkTree(occs As ComponentOccurrences, level As Integer, parentPath As String, _ tree As List(Of String), cons As List(Of String), visited As HashSet(Of String)) For Each occ As ComponentOccurrence In occs WriteOccurrence(occ, level, parentPath, tree, cons, visited) Next End Sub
Sub WriteOccurrence(occ As ComponentOccurrence, level As Integer, parentPath As String, _ tree As List(Of String), cons As List(Of String), visited As HashSet(Of String)) Dim occPath As String = parentPath & " > " & occ.Name Dim fullPath As String = "" Dim fileName As String = "" Dim fileType As String = "" Dim propSets As PropertySets = Nothing Dim isVirtual As Boolean = False
Try If TypeOf occ.Definition Is VirtualComponentDefinition Then isVirtual = True propSets = CType(occ.Definition, VirtualComponentDefinition).PropertySets fileName = "(virtual component)" fileType = "virtual" End If Catch End Try
If Not isVirtual Then Try fullPath = occ.ReferencedDocumentDescriptor.FullDocumentName fileName = System.IO.Path.GetFileName(fullPath) fileType = System.IO.Path.GetExtension(fullPath) Catch End Try Try propSets = CType(occ.Definition.Document, Document).PropertySets Catch ' suppressed occurrence -> document not loaded End Try End If
Dim bom As String = "" Try : bom = occ.BOMStructure.ToString().Replace("BOMStructure", "").TrimStart("k"c) : Catch : End Try
Dim grounded As String = "" Try : grounded = occ.Grounded.ToString() : Catch : End Try
tree.Add(Row(level.ToString(), _ New String(" "c, level * 3) & occ.Name, _ occPath, fileName, fileType, fullPath, _ GetProp(propSets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Part Number"), _ GetProp(propSets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Description"), _ GetProp(propSets, "Inventor Summary Information", "Revision Number"), _ GetProp(propSets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Material"), _ GetProp(propSets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Stock Number"), _ GetProp(propSets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Designer"), _ GetProp(propSets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Project"), _ bom, occ.Suppressed.ToString(), grounded, occ.Visible.ToString(), _ GetCustomProps(propSets)))
' Recurse into sub-assemblies If Not occ.Suppressed AndAlso occ.DefinitionDocumentType = DocumentTypeEnum.kAssemblyDocumentObject Then ' Constraints of each sub-assembly file are exported once (not per instance) Try Dim subDoc As AssemblyDocument = CType(occ.Definition.Document, AssemblyDocument) If Not visited.Contains(subDoc.FullFileName) Then visited.Add(subDoc.FullFileName) ExportConstraints(subDoc.ComponentDefinition, _ System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(subDoc.FullFileName), cons) End If Catch End Try
WalkTree(occ.SubOccurrences, level + 1, occPath, tree, cons, visited) End If End Sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Constraints + joints of one assembly definition ' --------------------------------------------------------------------- Sub ExportConstraints(def As AssemblyComponentDefinition, asmName As String, cons As List(Of String)) For Each c As AssemblyConstraint In def.Constraints Dim o1 As String = "(assembly geometry)" Dim o2 As String = "(assembly geometry)" Try If c.OccurrenceOne IsNot Nothing Then o1 = c.OccurrenceOne.Name Catch End Try Try If c.OccurrenceTwo IsNot Nothing Then o2 = c.OccurrenceTwo.Name Catch End Try
Dim value As String = "" Try Select Case c.Type Case ObjectTypeEnum.kMateConstraintObject : value = CType(c, MateConstraint).Offset.Expression Case ObjectTypeEnum.kFlushConstraintObject : value = CType(c, FlushConstraint).Offset.Expression Case ObjectTypeEnum.kAngleConstraintObject : value = CType(c, AngleConstraint).Angle.Expression Case ObjectTypeEnum.kTangentConstraintObject : value = CType(c, TangentConstraint).Offset.Expression Case ObjectTypeEnum.kInsertConstraintObject : value = CType(c, InsertConstraint).Distance.Expression End Select Catch End Try
Dim health As String = "" Try : health = c.HealthStatus.ToString().Replace("HealthStatus", "").TrimStart("k"c) : Catch : End Try
cons.Add(Row(asmName, "Constraint", c.Name, ConstraintTypeName(c.Type), o1, o2, _ value, c.Suppressed.ToString(), health)) Next
' Joints (Inventor 2014+) Try For Each j As AssemblyJoint In def.Joints Dim o1 As String = "", o2 As String = "" Try : o1 = j.OccurrenceOne.Name : Catch : End Try Try : o2 = j.OccurrenceTwo.Name : Catch : End Try Dim jType As String = "" Try : jType = j.Definition.JointType.ToString().Replace("JointType", "").TrimStart("k"c) : Catch : End Try Dim health As String = "" Try : health = j.HealthStatus.ToString().Replace("HealthStatus", "").TrimStart("k"c) : Catch : End Try cons.Add(Row(asmName, "Joint", j.Name, jType, o1, o2, "", j.Suppressed.ToString(), health)) Next Catch End Try End Sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Helpers ' --------------------------------------------------------------------- Function ConstraintTypeName(t As ObjectTypeEnum) As String Select Case t Case ObjectTypeEnum.kMateConstraintObject : Return "Mate" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kFlushConstraintObject : Return "Flush" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kAngleConstraintObject : Return "Angle" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kTangentConstraintObject : Return "Tangent" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kInsertConstraintObject : Return "Insert" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kSymmetryConstraintObject : Return "Symmetry" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kTransitionalConstraintObject : Return "Transitional" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kRotateRotateConstraintObject : Return "Motion (Rotation)" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kRotateTranslateConstraintObject : Return "Motion (Rotation-Translation)" Case Else : Return t.ToString() End Select End Function
Function GetProp(sets As PropertySets, setName As String, propName As String) As String If sets Is Nothing Then Return "" Try Dim v As Object = sets.Item(setName).Item(propName).Value If v Is Nothing Then Return "" Return v.ToString() Catch Return "" End Try End Function
' All custom iProperties as "Name=Value | Name=Value" Function GetCustomProps(sets As PropertySets) As String If sets Is Nothing Then Return "" Dim parts As New List(Of String) Try For Each p As [Property] In sets.Item("Inventor User Defined Properties") Dim v As String = "" Try : v = p.Value.ToString() : Catch : End Try parts.Add(p.Name & "=" & v) Next Catch End Try Return String.Join(" | ", parts.ToArray()) End Function
' Builds one CSV row with proper quoting Function Row(ParamArray fields() As String) As String ' German Excel expects ";" as the CSV separator. Change to "," if needed. Dim sep As String = ";" Dim q As New List(Of String) For Each f As String In fields If f Is Nothing Then f = "" q.Add("""" & f.Replace("""", """""") & """") Next Return String.Join(sep, q.ToArray()) End Function

' ===================================================================== ' Export Assembly Tree + iProperties + Constraints/Joints to XML ' iLogic rule - run from the top-level assembly (.iam) ' ' Output (written next to the assembly file): ' <AssemblyName>_Export.xml ' Open it in Edge/Chrome/Firefox to get a collapsible tree view. ' =====================================================================
Sub Main() Dim doc As Document = ThisDoc.Document If doc.DocumentType <> DocumentTypeEnum.kAssemblyDocumentObject Then MessageBox.Show("Please open an assembly (.iam) before running this rule.", _ "Export Assembly Tree", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning) Exit Sub End If
Dim asm As AssemblyDocument = CType(doc, AssemblyDocument) Dim asmName As String = System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(asm.FullFileName) Dim outFolder As String = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(asm.FullFileName) If String.IsNullOrEmpty(outFolder) Then outFolder = "C:\Temp" ' unsaved assembly If Not System.IO.Directory.Exists(outFolder) Then System.IO.Directory.CreateDirectory(outFolder)
Dim sb As New System.Text.StringBuilder() sb.AppendLine("<?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?>") sb.AppendLine("<AssemblyExport" & A("source", asm.FullFileName) & _ A("exported", DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")) & ">")
' ---------- Top-level assembly ---------- sb.AppendLine(Ind(1) & "<Component" & A("name", asmName) & A("level", "0") & _ A("file", System.IO.Path.GetFileName(asm.FullFileName)) & A("type", ".iam") & _ A("path", asm.FullFileName) & ">") WriteProperties(sb, asm.PropertySets, 2) WriteConstraints(sb, asm.ComponentDefinition, 2)
sb.AppendLine(Ind(2) & "<Components" & A("count", asm.ComponentDefinition.Occurrences.Count.ToString()) & ">") For Each occ As ComponentOccurrence In asm.ComponentDefinition.Occurrences WriteOccurrence(sb, occ, 1, 3) Next sb.AppendLine(Ind(2) & "</Components>") sb.AppendLine(Ind(1) & "</Component>") sb.AppendLine("</AssemblyExport>")
Dim outFile As String = System.IO.Path.Combine(outFolder, asmName & "_Export.xml") System.IO.File.WriteAllText(outFile, sb.ToString(), New System.Text.UTF8Encoding(False))
MessageBox.Show("Export complete:" & vbCrLf & outFile, _ "Export Assembly Tree", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information) End Sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------- ' One component (recursive for sub-assemblies) ' --------------------------------------------------------------------- Sub WriteOccurrence(sb As System.Text.StringBuilder, occ As ComponentOccurrence, level As Integer, depth As Integer) Dim fullPath As String = "" Dim fileName As String = "" Dim fileType As String = "" Dim propSets As PropertySets = Nothing Dim isVirtual As Boolean = False
Try If TypeOf occ.Definition Is VirtualComponentDefinition Then isVirtual = True propSets = CType(occ.Definition, VirtualComponentDefinition).PropertySets fileName = "(virtual component)" fileType = "virtual" End If Catch End Try
If Not isVirtual Then Try fullPath = occ.ReferencedDocumentDescriptor.FullDocumentName fileName = System.IO.Path.GetFileName(fullPath) fileType = System.IO.Path.GetExtension(fullPath) Catch End Try Try propSets = CType(occ.Definition.Document, Document).PropertySets Catch ' suppressed occurrence -> document not loaded End Try End If
Dim bom As String = "" Try : bom = occ.BOMStructure.ToString().Replace("BOMStructure", "").TrimStart("k"c) : Catch : End Try Dim grounded As String = "" Try : grounded = occ.Grounded.ToString() : Catch : End Try
sb.AppendLine(Ind(depth) & "<Component" & A("name", occ.Name) & A("level", level.ToString()) & _ A("file", fileName) & A("type", fileType) & A("path", fullPath) & _ A("bom", bom) & A("suppressed", occ.Suppressed.ToString()) & _ A("grounded", grounded) & A("visible", occ.Visible.ToString()) & ">")
WriteProperties(sb, propSets, depth + 1)
If Not occ.Suppressed AndAlso occ.DefinitionDocumentType = DocumentTypeEnum.kAssemblyDocumentObject Then Try Dim subDoc As AssemblyDocument = CType(occ.Definition.Document, AssemblyDocument) WriteConstraints(sb, subDoc.ComponentDefinition, depth + 1) Catch End Try
sb.AppendLine(Ind(depth + 1) & "<Components" & A("count", occ.SubOccurrences.Count.ToString()) & ">") For Each subOcc As ComponentOccurrence In occ.SubOccurrences WriteOccurrence(sb, subOcc, level + 1, depth + 2) Next sb.AppendLine(Ind(depth + 1) & "</Components>") End If
sb.AppendLine(Ind(depth) & "</Component>") End Sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------- ' iProperties (standard + custom) ' --------------------------------------------------------------------- Sub WriteProperties(sb As System.Text.StringBuilder, sets As PropertySets, depth As Integer) If sets Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
sb.AppendLine(Ind(depth) & "<iProperties>") WriteProp(sb, depth + 1, "Part Number", GetProp(sets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Part Number")) WriteProp(sb, depth + 1, "Description", GetProp(sets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Description")) WriteProp(sb, depth + 1, "Revision", GetProp(sets, "Inventor Summary Information", "Revision Number")) WriteProp(sb, depth + 1, "Material", GetProp(sets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Material")) WriteProp(sb, depth + 1, "Stock Number", GetProp(sets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Stock Number")) WriteProp(sb, depth + 1, "Designer", GetProp(sets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Designer")) WriteProp(sb, depth + 1, "Project", GetProp(sets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Project")) WriteProp(sb, depth + 1, "Vendor", GetProp(sets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Vendor")) WriteProp(sb, depth + 1, "Title", GetProp(sets, "Inventor Summary Information", "Title")) WriteProp(sb, depth + 1, "Author", GetProp(sets, "Inventor Summary Information", "Author")) sb.AppendLine(Ind(depth) & "</iProperties>")
Try Dim custom As PropertySet = sets.Item("Inventor User Defined Properties") If custom.Count > 0 Then sb.AppendLine(Ind(depth) & "<CustomProperties>") For Each p As [Property] In custom Dim v As String = "" Try : v = p.Value.ToString() : Catch : End Try WriteProp(sb, depth + 1, p.Name, v) Next sb.AppendLine(Ind(depth) & "</CustomProperties>") End If Catch End Try End Sub
Sub WriteProp(sb As System.Text.StringBuilder, depth As Integer, name As String, value As String) sb.AppendLine(Ind(depth) & "<Property" & A("name", name) & ">" & Esc(value) & "</Property>") End Sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Constraints + joints of one assembly definition ' --------------------------------------------------------------------- Sub WriteConstraints(sb As System.Text.StringBuilder, def As AssemblyComponentDefinition, depth As Integer) sb.AppendLine(Ind(depth) & "<Constraints" & A("count", def.Constraints.Count.ToString()) & ">")
For Each c As AssemblyConstraint In def.Constraints Dim o1 As String = "(assembly geometry)" Dim o2 As String = "(assembly geometry)" Try If c.OccurrenceOne IsNot Nothing Then o1 = c.OccurrenceOne.Name Catch End Try Try If c.OccurrenceTwo IsNot Nothing Then o2 = c.OccurrenceTwo.Name Catch End Try
Dim value As String = "" Try Select Case c.Type Case ObjectTypeEnum.kMateConstraintObject : value = CType(c, MateConstraint).Offset.Expression Case ObjectTypeEnum.kFlushConstraintObject : value = CType(c, FlushConstraint).Offset.Expression Case ObjectTypeEnum.kAngleConstraintObject : value = CType(c, AngleConstraint).Angle.Expression Case ObjectTypeEnum.kTangentConstraintObject : value = CType(c, TangentConstraint).Offset.Expression Case ObjectTypeEnum.kInsertConstraintObject : value = CType(c, InsertConstraint).Distance.Expression End Select Catch End Try
Dim health As String = "" Try : health = c.HealthStatus.ToString().Replace("HealthStatus", "").TrimStart("k"c) : Catch : End Try
sb.AppendLine(Ind(depth + 1) & "<Constraint" & A("name", c.Name) & _ A("type", ConstraintTypeName(c.Type)) & A("component1", o1) & _ A("component2", o2) & A("value", value) & _ A("suppressed", c.Suppressed.ToString()) & A("health", health) & " />") Next sb.AppendLine(Ind(depth) & "</Constraints>")
' Joints (Inventor 2014+) Try If def.Joints.Count > 0 Then sb.AppendLine(Ind(depth) & "<Joints" & A("count", def.Joints.Count.ToString()) & ">") For Each j As AssemblyJoint In def.Joints Dim o1 As String = "", o2 As String = "", jType As String = "", health As String = "" Try : o1 = j.OccurrenceOne.Name : Catch : End Try Try : o2 = j.OccurrenceTwo.Name : Catch : End Try Try : jType = j.Definition.JointType.ToString().Replace("JointType", "").TrimStart("k"c) : Catch : End Try Try : health = j.HealthStatus.ToString().Replace("HealthStatus", "").TrimStart("k"c) : Catch : End Try sb.AppendLine(Ind(depth + 1) & "<Joint" & A("name", j.Name) & A("type", jType) & _ A("component1", o1) & A("component2", o2) & _ A("suppressed", j.Suppressed.ToString()) & A("health", health) & " />") Next sb.AppendLine(Ind(depth) & "</Joints>") End If Catch End Try End Sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Helpers ' --------------------------------------------------------------------- Function ConstraintTypeName(t As ObjectTypeEnum) As String Select Case t Case ObjectTypeEnum.kMateConstraintObject : Return "Mate" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kFlushConstraintObject : Return "Flush" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kAngleConstraintObject : Return "Angle" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kTangentConstraintObject : Return "Tangent" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kInsertConstraintObject : Return "Insert" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kSymmetryConstraintObject : Return "Symmetry" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kTransitionalConstraintObject : Return "Transitional" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kRotateRotateConstraintObject : Return "Motion (Rotation)" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kRotateTranslateConstraintObject : Return "Motion (Rotation-Translation)" Case Else : Return t.ToString() End Select End Function
Function GetProp(sets As PropertySets, setName As String, propName As String) As String If sets Is Nothing Then Return "" Try Dim v As Object = sets.Item(setName).Item(propName).Value If v Is Nothing Then Return "" Return v.ToString() Catch Return "" End Try End Function
' XML attribute: name="escaped value" Function A(name As String, value As String) As String Return " " & name & "=""" & Esc(value) & """" End Function
' Escape & < > " ' for XML Function Esc(s As String) As String If s Is Nothing Then Return "" Return s.Replace("&", "&").Replace("<", "<").Replace(">", ">") _ .Replace("""", """).Replace("'", "'") End Function
' Indentation Function Ind(depth As Integer) As String Return New String(" "c, depth * 2) End Function

' ===================================================================== ' Export Assembly Tree + iProperties + Constraints/Joints to XML ' (same rows and columns as the CSV version) ' iLogic rule - run from the top-level assembly (.iam) ' ' Output (written next to the assembly file): ' <AssemblyName>_Tree.xml -> full component tree with iProperties ' <AssemblyName>_Constraints.xml -> all constraints + joints, every level ' Open in a browser to read, or in Excel (Data > Get Data > From XML) ' to get the same table as the CSV. ' =====================================================================
Sub Main() Dim doc As Document = ThisDoc.Document If doc.DocumentType <> DocumentTypeEnum.kAssemblyDocumentObject Then MessageBox.Show("Please open an assembly (.iam) before running this rule.", _ "Export Assembly Tree", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning) Exit Sub End If
Dim asm As AssemblyDocument = CType(doc, AssemblyDocument) Dim asmName As String = System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(asm.FullFileName) Dim outFolder As String = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(asm.FullFileName) If String.IsNullOrEmpty(outFolder) Then outFolder = "C:\Temp" ' unsaved assembly If Not System.IO.Directory.Exists(outFolder) Then System.IO.Directory.CreateDirectory(outFolder)
' ---------- Tree ---------- Dim tree As New List(Of String) tree.Add(Row("Level", "Tree", "Occurrence Path", "File Name", "File Type", "Full Path", _ "Part Number", "Description", "Revision", "Material", "Stock Number", _ "Designer", "Project", "BOM Structure", "Suppressed", "Grounded", _ "Visible", "Custom iProperties"))
' Row for the top-level assembly itself tree.Add(Row("0", asmName, asmName, System.IO.Path.GetFileName(asm.FullFileName), ".iam", _ asm.FullFileName, _ GetProp(asm.PropertySets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Part Number"), _ GetProp(asm.PropertySets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Description"), _ GetProp(asm.PropertySets, "Inventor Summary Information", "Revision Number"), _ "", _ GetProp(asm.PropertySets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Stock Number"), _ GetProp(asm.PropertySets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Designer"), _ GetProp(asm.PropertySets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Project"), _ asm.ComponentDefinition.BOMStructure.ToString(), "False", "", "True", _ GetCustomProps(asm.PropertySets)))
' ---------- Constraints / Joints ---------- Dim cons As New List(Of String) cons.Add(Row("Assembly", "Kind", "Name", "Type", "Component 1", "Component 2", _ "Offset / Angle", "Suppressed", "Health"))
Dim visited As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ExportConstraints(asm.ComponentDefinition, asmName, cons) visited.Add(asm.FullFileName)
WalkTree(asm.ComponentDefinition.Occurrences, 1, asmName, tree, cons, visited)
' ---------- Write files ---------- Dim treeFile As String = System.IO.Path.Combine(outFolder, asmName & "_Tree.xml") Dim consFile As String = System.IO.Path.Combine(outFolder, asmName & "_Constraints.xml") WriteXml(treeFile, "AssemblyTree", "Component", asm.FullFileName, tree) WriteXml(consFile, "AssemblyConstraints", "Constraint", asm.FullFileName, cons)
MessageBox.Show("Export complete:" & vbCrLf & treeFile & vbCrLf & consFile, _ "Export Assembly Tree", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information) End Sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Recursive tree walk ' --------------------------------------------------------------------- Sub WalkTree(occs As ComponentOccurrencesEnumerator, level As Integer, parentPath As String, _ tree As List(Of String), cons As List(Of String), visited As HashSet(Of String)) For Each occ As ComponentOccurrence In occs WriteOccurrence(occ, level, parentPath, tree, cons, visited) Next End Sub
' Top level uses ComponentOccurrences (different type than the enumerator) Sub WalkTree(occs As ComponentOccurrences, level As Integer, parentPath As String, _ tree As List(Of String), cons As List(Of String), visited As HashSet(Of String)) For Each occ As ComponentOccurrence In occs WriteOccurrence(occ, level, parentPath, tree, cons, visited) Next End Sub
Sub WriteOccurrence(occ As ComponentOccurrence, level As Integer, parentPath As String, _ tree As List(Of String), cons As List(Of String), visited As HashSet(Of String)) Dim occPath As String = parentPath & " > " & occ.Name Dim fullPath As String = "" Dim fileName As String = "" Dim fileType As String = "" Dim propSets As PropertySets = Nothing Dim isVirtual As Boolean = False
Try If TypeOf occ.Definition Is VirtualComponentDefinition Then isVirtual = True propSets = CType(occ.Definition, VirtualComponentDefinition).PropertySets fileName = "(virtual component)" fileType = "virtual" End If Catch End Try
If Not isVirtual Then Try fullPath = occ.ReferencedDocumentDescriptor.FullDocumentName fileName = System.IO.Path.GetFileName(fullPath) fileType = System.IO.Path.GetExtension(fullPath) Catch End Try Try propSets = CType(occ.Definition.Document, Document).PropertySets Catch ' suppressed occurrence -> document not loaded End Try End If
Dim bom As String = "" Try : bom = occ.BOMStructure.ToString().Replace("BOMStructure", "").TrimStart("k"c) : Catch : End Try
Dim grounded As String = "" Try : grounded = occ.Grounded.ToString() : Catch : End Try
tree.Add(Row(level.ToString(), _ New String(" "c, level * 3) & occ.Name, _ occPath, fileName, fileType, fullPath, _ GetProp(propSets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Part Number"), _ GetProp(propSets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Description"), _ GetProp(propSets, "Inventor Summary Information", "Revision Number"), _ GetProp(propSets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Material"), _ GetProp(propSets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Stock Number"), _ GetProp(propSets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Designer"), _ GetProp(propSets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Project"), _ bom, occ.Suppressed.ToString(), grounded, occ.Visible.ToString(), _ GetCustomProps(propSets)))
' Recurse into sub-assemblies If Not occ.Suppressed AndAlso occ.DefinitionDocumentType = DocumentTypeEnum.kAssemblyDocumentObject Then ' Constraints of each sub-assembly file are exported once (not per instance) Try Dim subDoc As AssemblyDocument = CType(occ.Definition.Document, AssemblyDocument) If Not visited.Contains(subDoc.FullFileName) Then visited.Add(subDoc.FullFileName) ExportConstraints(subDoc.ComponentDefinition, _ System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(subDoc.FullFileName), cons) End If Catch End Try
WalkTree(occ.SubOccurrences, level + 1, occPath, tree, cons, visited) End If End Sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Constraints + joints of one assembly definition ' --------------------------------------------------------------------- Sub ExportConstraints(def As AssemblyComponentDefinition, asmName As String, cons As List(Of String)) For Each c As AssemblyConstraint In def.Constraints Dim o1 As String = "(assembly geometry)" Dim o2 As String = "(assembly geometry)" Try If c.OccurrenceOne IsNot Nothing Then o1 = c.OccurrenceOne.Name Catch End Try Try If c.OccurrenceTwo IsNot Nothing Then o2 = c.OccurrenceTwo.Name Catch End Try
Dim value As String = "" Try Select Case c.Type Case ObjectTypeEnum.kMateConstraintObject : value = CType(c, MateConstraint).Offset.Expression Case ObjectTypeEnum.kFlushConstraintObject : value = CType(c, FlushConstraint).Offset.Expression Case ObjectTypeEnum.kAngleConstraintObject : value = CType(c, AngleConstraint).Angle.Expression Case ObjectTypeEnum.kTangentConstraintObject : value = CType(c, TangentConstraint).Offset.Expression Case ObjectTypeEnum.kInsertConstraintObject : value = CType(c, InsertConstraint).Distance.Expression End Select Catch End Try
Dim health As String = "" Try : health = c.HealthStatus.ToString().Replace("HealthStatus", "").TrimStart("k"c) : Catch : End Try
cons.Add(Row(asmName, "Constraint", c.Name, ConstraintTypeName(c.Type), o1, o2, _ value, c.Suppressed.ToString(), health)) Next
' Joints (Inventor 2014+) Try For Each j As AssemblyJoint In def.Joints Dim o1 As String = "", o2 As String = "" Try : o1 = j.OccurrenceOne.Name : Catch : End Try Try : o2 = j.OccurrenceTwo.Name : Catch : End Try Dim jType As String = "" Try : jType = j.Definition.JointType.ToString().Replace("JointType", "").TrimStart("k"c) : Catch : End Try Dim health As String = "" Try : health = j.HealthStatus.ToString().Replace("HealthStatus", "").TrimStart("k"c) : Catch : End Try cons.Add(Row(asmName, "Joint", j.Name, jType, o1, o2, "", j.Suppressed.ToString(), health)) Next Catch End Try End Sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Helpers ' --------------------------------------------------------------------- Function ConstraintTypeName(t As ObjectTypeEnum) As String Select Case t Case ObjectTypeEnum.kMateConstraintObject : Return "Mate" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kFlushConstraintObject : Return "Flush" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kAngleConstraintObject : Return "Angle" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kTangentConstraintObject : Return "Tangent" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kInsertConstraintObject : Return "Insert" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kSymmetryConstraintObject : Return "Symmetry" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kTransitionalConstraintObject : Return "Transitional" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kRotateRotateConstraintObject : Return "Motion (Rotation)" Case ObjectTypeEnum.kRotateTranslateConstraintObject : Return "Motion (Rotation-Translation)" Case Else : Return t.ToString() End Select End Function
Function GetProp(sets As PropertySets, setName As String, propName As String) As String If sets Is Nothing Then Return "" Try Dim v As Object = sets.Item(setName).Item(propName).Value If v Is Nothing Then Return "" Return v.ToString() Catch Return "" End Try End Function
' All custom iProperties as "Name=Value | Name=Value" Function GetCustomProps(sets As PropertySets) As String If sets Is Nothing Then Return "" Dim parts As New List(Of String) Try For Each p As [Property] In sets.Item("Inventor User Defined Properties") Dim v As String = "" Try : v = p.Value.ToString() : Catch : End Try parts.Add(p.Name & "=" & v) Next Catch End Try Return String.Join(" | ", parts.ToArray()) End Function
' Builds one row; fields are joined with an invisible separator ' and turned into XML elements in WriteXml Function Row(ParamArray fields() As String) As String Dim q As New List(Of String) For Each f As String In fields If f Is Nothing Then f = "" q.Add(f.Replace(Chr(31), " ")) Next Return String.Join(Chr(31).ToString(), q.ToArray()) End Function
' Writes the rows as XML. First row = column names. ' <AssemblyTree source="..." exported="..."> ' <Component> ' <Level>1</Level> ' <PartNumber>...</PartNumber> ' ... Sub WriteXml(filePath As String, rootTag As String, itemTag As String, source As String, rows As List(Of String)) Dim sep As Char = Chr(31) Dim headers() As String = rows(0).Split(sep) For i As Integer = 0 To headers.Length - 1 headers(i) = TagName(headers(i)) Next
Dim sb As New System.Text.StringBuilder() sb.AppendLine("<?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?>") sb.AppendLine("<" & rootTag & " source=""" & Esc(source) & """ exported=""" & _ DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm") & """>") For r As Integer = 1 To rows.Count - 1 Dim vals() As String = rows(r).Split(sep) sb.AppendLine(" <" & itemTag & ">") For i As Integer = 0 To headers.Length - 1 Dim v As String = "" If i < vals.Length Then v = vals(i) sb.AppendLine(" <" & headers(i) & ">" & Esc(v) & "</" & headers(i) & ">") Next sb.AppendLine(" </" & itemTag & ">") Next sb.AppendLine("</" & rootTag & ">")
System.IO.File.WriteAllText(filePath, sb.ToString(), New System.Text.UTF8Encoding(False)) End Sub
' "Component 1" -> "Component1", "Offset / Angle" -> "OffsetAngle" Function TagName(header As String) As String Dim t As New System.Text.StringBuilder() For Each ch As Char In header If Char.IsLetterOrDigit(ch) Then t.Append(ch) Next Return t.ToString() End Function
' Escape & < > " ' for XML Function Esc(s As String) As String If s Is Nothing Then Return "" Return s.Replace("&", "&").Replace("<", "<").Replace(">", ">") _ .Replace("""", """).Replace("'", "'") End Function
